# Libraries

The libraries being used are as follows:

Rqc: early quality evaluation

```{r}
lapply(c("Rqc", "fastqcr"), library, character.only = T)
```

# Non-R Tools

The following tools from conda and Docker are used

# File Downloads and Declaration

Ensure the files being processed are accessible in your working directory

```{r}
p_kluyveri <- "data/raw_data/p_kluyveri"
n_populi <- "data/raw_data/n_populi"
n_holstii <- "data/raw_data/n_holstii"

```

# QC

Perform early quality-control of reads to ensure that they are usable for further processing. Done by checking read quality using Rqc charts.

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqc_qc <- rqc(path = "data/raw_data", pattern = "", openBrowser = FALSE, outdir = "outputs")

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqcCycleQualityBoxPlot(rqc_qc)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqcCycleBaseCallsLinePlot(rqc_qc)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqcReadFrequencyPlot(rqc_qc)
```
